title: Kentucky Department of Education publishes AI in Kentucky K-12 guidance
body: KDE maintains a public page for AI in Kentucky K-12, including state task force context and education guidance.

title: UofL launches Kentucky Center for Digital Innovation

title: UofL high-performance computing system accelerates AI-assisted research
body: UofL highlighted AI-assisted research using the Zurada high-performance computing system, including materials work led by Badri Narayanan.

title: University of Kentucky maintains a generative AI research guide

title: Two public Kentucky universities launch AI degrees
body: Public radio coverage tracks new artificial intelligence degree activity at Kentucky universities.

title: Anthropic and TeraWulf commit to long-term Hawesville AI data center campus

title: Data centers eye Kentucky idle industrial sites for power access
body: Kentucky Lantern coverage follows hyperscale data center interest in industrial sites, power access, and community impacts.

title: Kentucky legislature's AI task force makes recommendations
body: Public radio coverage follows the Kentucky Artificial Intelligence Task Force and recommendations around AI work groups, literacy, governance, and data center policy.

title: Eastern Kentucky workforce voice included in AI literacy training conversation
body: WorkforceGPS event materials include Bridget Back of Eastern Kentucky Concentrated Employment Program in a national AI literacy and workforce training discussion.

body: Coverage of UofL's Kentucky Center for Digital Innovation notes public awareness events and expanded AI and cyber programs.
